name: FRAME Enterprise AI Governance
description: Governance envelope for enterprise AI deployment across Focus, Roles, Authority, Metrics, and Evaluation (Ian Loe, Tactics Solutions, CC BY-NC 4.0).

requirements.title: Focus
requirements.description: Domain, scope, intended outcome, and data suitability.

requirements.title: Roles
requirements.description: Accountable owner, human oversight, and escalation path.

requirements.title: Authority
requirements.description: Decision rights separated into autonomous, human-confirmed, and out of scope.

requirements.title: Metrics
requirements.description: Activity metrics separated from outcome metrics, quality, and value.

requirements.title: Evaluation
requirements.description: Ongoing review of performance, objective alignment, compliance, and adoption.

name: AI Agent Evaluation Framework (AAEF)
description: Workforce-style appraisal framework for AI agents across five dimensions and four performance profiles (Ian Loe, Tactics Solutions, CC BY-NC 4.0).

requirements.title: Task Competence
requirements.description: Accuracy, reliability, and completion quality on assigned tasks.

requirements.title: Judgement Quality
requirements.description: Appropriate handling of ambiguity, edge cases, and escalation triggers.

requirements.title: Boundary Adherence
requirements.description: Binary adherence to sanctioned authority rules without breach.

requirements.title: Collaboration Effectiveness
requirements.description: Clarity, handoff quality, and responsiveness with human overseers and peers.

requirements.title: Improvement Trajectory
requirements.description: Directional trend across successive appraisal cycles.

name: COSO Internal Control & ERM
description: Enterprise Risk Management and internal control principles.

requirements.title: Control Environment
requirements.description: Tone at the top, accountability, and oversight structures.

requirements.title: Risk Assessment
requirements.description: Identification and analysis of risks to achieving objectives.

requirements.title: Control Activities
requirements.description: Policies, approvals, and technical controls mitigating risk.

requirements.title: Monitoring Activities
requirements.description: Ongoing and separate evaluations of control effectiveness.

name: NIST AI RMF
description: National Institute of Standards and Technology AI Risk Management Framework.

requirements.title: Govern
requirements.description: Cultivate and implement a culture of AI risk management.

requirements.title: Map
requirements.description: Contextualise AI system purpose, risks, and impacts.

requirements.title: Measure
requirements.description: Assess, analyse, and track AI risks and performance.

requirements.title: Manage
requirements.description: Prioritise and act on mapped and measured risks.

name: ISO/IEC 42001
description: International standard for Artificial Intelligence Management Systems (AIMS).

requirements.title: Leadership and Commitment
requirements.description: Top management accountability, AI policy, and roles.

requirements.title: Planning and Risk Assessment
requirements.description: AI risk assessment, impact assessment, and objectives.

requirements.title: Operation
requirements.description: Operational planning, AI system lifecycle, and third-party controls.

requirements.title: Performance Evaluation
requirements.description: Monitoring, measurement, internal audit, and management review.

name: EU AI Act
description: European Union Regulation laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence.

requirements.title: Risk Management System
requirements.description: Continuous iterative risk management throughout lifecycle.

requirements.title: Human Oversight
requirements.description: Effective human oversight measures and intervention capability.

requirements.title: Accuracy, Robustness and Cybersecurity
requirements.description: Resilience against errors, faults, and adversarial attacks.

requirements.title: Serious Incident Reporting
requirements.description: Logging and reporting of serious AI incidents.

name: Singapore MAS FEAT & IMDA Model AI Governance Framework
description: Singapore Monetary Authority FEAT principles and IMDA Model AI Governance Framework (including Generative AI).

requirements.title: Internal Governance Structures
requirements.description: Clear roles, responsibilities, and board oversight for AI.

requirements.title: Human Involvement in Decision-Making
requirements.description: Appropriate human-in-the-loop or human-over-the-loop degree.

requirements.title: Fairness, Ethics, Accountability, Transparency
requirements.description: Justifiable, fair, and explainable AI outcomes.

requirements.title: Operations Management and Incident Readiness
requirements.description: Monitoring, testing, and incident response for deployed models.
